findings: Processed current NANPA-valid shard-C NPAs 281, 302, and 305 in numeric order after completed 203/206/209/212/215/218/224/227/239/248/251/254/260/269/272.

Retained 7 current public organizations: Space City Anarchist Organization; Houston Food Not Bombs; Food Not Bombs Wilmington; Tide Shift Justice Project; Black Rose/Rosa Negra Miami Local; South Florida ABCF; and Food Not Bombs Miami.

Space City Anarchist Organization, Black Rose/Rosa Negra Miami Local, and South Florida ABCF are explicitly anarchist/anarchist-federation organizations by first-party sources. Food Not Bombs organizations are retained as anarchist-associated mutual aid without inferring individual affiliation. Tide Shift Justice Project is retained as adjacent, not anarchist.

Black Rose/Rosa Negra Miami Local and South Florida ABCF already had canonical org and recursive-target records and were reused rather than duplicated; this pass adds current NPA-305 relations and source provenance.
Five new organization names returned no repository code-search matches before packet creation; two existing canonical organizations were intentionally reused.

Public social endpoints surfaced/reused include Food Not Bombs Miami Instagram @foodnotbombsmiami and South Florida ABCF Instagram @abc.sfl; no directly public chat/server invite was confirmed in this bounded pass.
data.method: Authoritative NANPA membership gate; literal NPA searches plus locality-derived public-web searches; first-party/chapter-directory current-status verification; repository dedupe search; canonical StarIntel packet materialization.
data.research_question: Which current public anarchist, anarchist-associated, mutual-aid, and closely adjacent organizations are discoverable from the next unresolved shard-C U.S. geographic NPAs?
